items.title: The pullback of an invertible module is invertible
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of an invertible module is invertible (author lemma at source lines 4359-4364, label lemma-pullback-invertible). The proof (source lines 4366-4374) chooses an inverse of the given module, pulls back the trivialising isomorphism and uses the compatibility of the pullback with the tensor product to exhibit an inverse of the pulled back module (proof lines 4367-4373). The transport of the trivialisation along the pullback is the content. H2.
